summary: DataMeds AI, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a voluntary one-time distribution of Dream Bowl 2026 Meme Coins by Datavault AI Inc. to DataMeds shareholders of record as of August 7, 2026. Each share receives 50 meme coins, payable starting September 9, 2026, contingent on shareholders setting up a Datavault digital wallet and submitting an opt-in agreement via the distribution website hosted by information agent Alliance Advisors. This is a promotional non-cash distribution to DataMeds licensing partner's token holders, not a securities transaction. Watch for shareholder participation and regulatory scrutiny of meme-coin distributions.
